_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored.
_queue_file: Path the WSL `lister export-queue` writes. From Windows the WSL repo is reachable at \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\home\<user>\Lister. Adjust the distro name and username.
_results_file: Where this applier writes results for `lister import-results` to read.
_log_dir: Run logs + debug screenshots. Relative paths resolve next to applier.py.
_locator: How on-screen elements are found: 'claude-cli' (free, uses your Claude Max subscription) or 'api' (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
_claude_cli_path: Path to the claude CLI on Windows. 'claude' if it is on PATH; otherwise the full path to claude.exe / claude.cmd.
_api_model: Vision model used only when locator is 'api'.
_failsafe: If true, slamming the mouse into a screen corner aborts the run. Keep true while testing.
_timing: Randomized delay ranges [min, max] in seconds. Higher = slower but more human-looking.
